title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Step Functions
description: Create an API Gateway HTTP APIs endpoint that starts a Step Functions syncronous Express Workflow

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template deploys a HTTP APIs endpoint with an integration that syncronsouly invokes a Step Functions Express workflow and returns the response. The SAM template contains the minimum IAM resources required to run the application with logging enabled.
The HTTP's API endpoint can be called from an application (e.g. a web front end) to run an express workflow and return the result.
